title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: build-breaking borrow error in Fragment::from_bytes non-All-1 case
description:
In `Fragment::from_bytes` (fragment.rs:263), the non-All-1 case returns `payload: &body[2..2 + content_len]` where `body` is a stack-local `[u8; TILE_SIZE + 1 + MIC_LENGTH]` array. The borrow checker rejects this with E0515 (cannot return value referencing local variable). The code does not compile.

Fix: `from_bytes` must either use `&data` (after correct extraction) or take a caller-provided buffer for output. The old code took `&mut [u8]` output buffer. The new API dropped that parameter but didn't handle the lifetime correctly.
